messages:
acme_prod_ops: Hey team — we started seeing 503 spikes for our hosted inference calls from our EU region around 09:07 UTC. Happens for both streaming and non-streaming. Example curl returns HTTP/1.1 503 and body 'upstream overloaded'. SDK retries are looping and billing showed a token rate jump.
jana_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a minimal repro (timestamp, request id if available, and whether you were using batch inputs)? Also did you notice any change in request size or concurrency?
acme_prod_ops: Repro steps: 1) Hit POST /v1/generate with 10 simultaneous requests using node SDK v1.4.2, content-length ~6k tokens total per request. 2) Observed 503s within ~30s. Sample request_id: req_eu_20240621_091234. We were on default batching, no explicit keepalive changes. No other region affected.
sasha_sre: Thanks — tagging me. I'm pulling logs for req_eu_20240621_091234. Initial look: edge proxies started returning 503s and 504s, upstream inference pool showed high queue lengths. Putting a small probe in now.
li_dev: Could be prefix cache eviction thrash + batching surge. Any chance customer sent a burst of unique prompts (low cache-hit)? That inflates server work per token. Also which model and quantization are they using?
acme_prod_ops: Using rwd-13b-v1 (qat-int8). Prompts were varied (user-generated). We didn't change client behavior.
sasha_sre: Log snippet: 
```
[edge-proxy-eu-2] 2025-07-15T09:07:42Z upstream_return=503 upstream_queue_len=128 conn_inflight=300
[serving-node-x] 2025-07-15T09:07:43Z batch_size=1 queued_tokens=120000 latency_p95=980ms
```
This looks like backpressure at the edge + degraded batching efficiency.
jana_support: FYI customer reports SDK retry loop causing double billing. They want ETA and mitigation.
sasha_sre: Immediate mitigation: 1) Ask client to reduce concurrency to 4 for EU region and enable exponential backoff (sdk config: retries: { maxAttempts:3, baseDelayMs:200, factor:2 }). 2) We're going to roll a config to increase edge proxy soft limit for queued connections for 10m to drain. I'll coordinate with infra.
acme_prod_ops: Ok we'll throttle on our side now. Any server-side ETA for fix?
sasha_sre: Infra will lift the soft queue cap in ~5m, then we will observe. Longer-term: we think the problem is high unique prompt diversity causing lots of short batches; we should add request routing to fall back to a lower-cost model variant when queue>threshold. Filing a follow-up with eng.
li_dev: For follow-up, I'll open an internal ticket to evaluate dynamic model-fallback policy and tune batching thresholds. Also recommend advising customers to enable client-side connection reuse (keepalive) — that reduces proxy connection churn.
deploy-bot: [deploy] edge-config-change eu-soft-queue-capacity +50% scheduled by sasha_sre, rollout id: roll_20250715_eu_042
sasha_sre: Update: edge config change completed. Early metrics show queued connections down 40% and 503 rate for acme dropped to near zero. Still watching for 10m.
jana_support: I'll update the customer with the mitigation steps and ask them to confirm they see stabilized behavior. Also offering a credit if they confirm billing spike due to our retries.
acme_prod_ops: Stabilized here after we throttled. Thanks for the quick response. Please keep us posted on the follow-up ticket and any SDK guidance we should apply permanently.
li_dev: Follow-up ticket: ENG-5421 — dynamic-fallback-and-batching-tuning. Assigned to li_dev, target: triage this week.
sasha_sre: Closing loop: will monitor for 1h then file incident if recurrence. If anyone sees related alerts, ping #eng-oncall.
jana_support: Customer comms sent: "We're seeing reduced errors and have applied a temporary edge config change; we'll follow up with permanent mitigations. If you saw a billing anomaly, please reply with the affected invoices and we'll investigate." :thumbsup:
acme_prod_ops: Thanks all. We'll send invoice ids if billing shows unexpected charges.
